The study was led by the Helmholtz Centre for Environmental Research with contributions from the Potsdam Institute for Climate Impact Research (PIK).

item.title: 'Rivers in the sky' influence marine heat waves
item.description: [Climate & Environment] Keyword: climate change — Long, narrow bands of moving moisture in the sky, known as atmospheric rivers, contribute to heat waves in the marine environment, according to a new study published in Nature Communications by researchers from Duke University's Nicholas School of the Environment. It is the result of millions of years of changes that have reshaped the tropical landscape time and again.

item.description: [Diabetes & Kidney Disease] Keyword: type 2 diabetes — A healthy lifestyle can prevent type 2 diabetes for many people, but new research suggests that weight loss alone may not be enough for one particularly vulnerable group.
